annotations.text:
FlashTeX — Mac LaTeX IDE
Undergraduates first, advanced authors eventually.

Matches the vocabulary already in apps/mac: .bar chrome, source badges, SF Symbol diagnostic semantics, UTF-8 byte readouts.
Recovery is a first-class state, not an error screen. The preview stays visible, recovered regions are marked as provisional, and every diagnostic says what was rendered instead.
Capture never auto-inserts. The Mac shows the proposal, its ambiguities and its required packages, and applies one undoable edit only after approval.
